notes:
- POV summary: HarborBridge processes long legal exhibits and needs deterministic inference for downstream redaction and summarization.
- Primary workload: RAG-enabled longform summarization + follow-up chat. Must support context windows up to 64k tokens (subset of pipeline).
- Performance targets: sustained 150-200 RPS for short chat (<= 64 tokens), p50 ~20ms, p95 <= 40ms, p99 target <= 120ms for 512-token responses during dedicated capacity.
- Cost sensitivity: wants reserved commit to reduce unit cost; prefers predictable per-month spend rather than pay-as-you-go spikes.
- Model preferences: open to quantized Llama-family variants or RedSea-v2; prefer evaluation on int8 first, willing to test int4 if quality delta acceptable.
- Tuning asks: provide recommended quantization profiles + per-model kernel set, explicit guidance on batching window and KV cache TTLs to avoid cold-start spikes.
- Quote from CTO: "We need tight P99s — legal customers will not tolerate inconsistent latency during depositions."
- Integration notes: SSO via Okta required; audit logs to SIEM (Splunk) and KMS key rotation policy mandatory.
- Linked artifacts: draft SOW, Dedicated sizing spreadsheet, perf logs from 2026-02-08 run (see drive links).
capacity_plan: SE recommended baseline: 6 x H100-80GB reserved nodes (dedicated), 2-node autoscale burst for peak windows; plan includes KV-cache prefilling and local SSDs for checkpoint caching. Alternative: 8 x A100-80GB if H100 procurement delayed.
performance_requirements: Throughput: 150-200 RPS (chat short), 20-30 RPS sustained for 512-token summarization; Latency SLOs (target): p50 <= 20ms (short), p95 <= 40ms, p99 <= 120ms for 512-token generations. Tail tolerances discussed in SLA. Warm KV cache required for sub-100ms paths on repeated doc queries.
model_tuning_requirements: Context length: support up to 64k tokens for RAG pipeline (span-windowing for retrieval). Quantization: evaluate int8 profiles first, then int4 with mixed-precision fallback; recommend per-model quant profile and kernel selection. Batching policy: dynamic batching up to 64 tokens or 512-token aggregated batch window with max-latency 20ms. KV cache: persistent cache across requests with TTL 12h for active cases; cache eviction policy to be tunable by route.
sla_negotiation_points: Hard ask: P99 latency SLA for production dedicated capacity; uptime 99.95% with credit schedule, defined maintenance windows, clear incident RTAs for hardware failures, and explicit fallback to hosted variants during full-capacity outages. Legal asks for indemnity language around data residency and on-prem components.
security_docs_requested: SOC2 report, ISO27001 cert, data residency matrix, KMS integration guide, network architecture for VPC private lane
